name: ai-monitor-zywienia
description: AI Monitor żywienia - web frontend packaged as native Android and iOS apps with Capacitor.

scripts.native:android:init: npm run build:web && npx cap add android
scripts.native:android:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.native:ios:init: npm run build:web && npx cap add ios && bash scripts/configure-ios.sh
scripts.native:ios:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync ios && bash scripts/configure-ios.sh
